units.source_text: 最后一句话刚说完，赫卟夫人猛然清醒过来了。

en.t: As soon as the final words had been spoken, Mrs. Hepp suddenly came back to her senses.

units.source_text: 我等十七名会员向在神起誓，这番对话是真实可信的。

en.t: We seventeen members swear before God that this conversation is true and trustworthy.

units.source_text: （再说了，对我等信任的赫卟夫人的报酬，已经按照夫人过去当女演员时的日薪标准付过去了。）

en.t: Besides, Mrs. Hepp, who trusted us, has already been paid according to the daily wage she used to receive when she was an actress.
